_comment: Everything that shapes pressure. Loaded at startup, shown on the admin page, and read by the scenario generator so a scenario is generated against the tunables it will be played with. Changing any key marked (validator) invalidates existing scenarios.
_radio_transcript_fallback_note: false — audio failure voids the session; there is never a transcript fallback
_challenge_blocks_doors_note: false — the challenge modal never locks the station canvas; time is never frozen and doors stay operable
_tts_sentence_gap_note: Silence inserted between sentences of a spoken message. Radio messages carry no transcript, so a wall of run-together speech is unintelligible rather than merely hard: the pause is what lets a listener separate one instruction from the next. Changing it changes every audio_duration, so the bank must be re-rendered and re-validated.
_tts_door_emphasis_note: A door name is the single most important word in a spoken instruction and the shortest, so it is rendered slower than the surrounding speech and given a short pause either side. Set tts_door_pause_seconds to 0 and tts_door_length_scale to 1.0 to turn the emphasis off. Changing either changes every audio_duration, so the bank must be re-rendered and re-validated.
